name: Szadek
description: Dimir guildmaster who orchestrates the Guildpact's collapse and kills Augustin IV as a ghost.

description_citations.text: "The Dissension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek expresses mixed feelings about sphinxes.
timeline.quote: Their wisdom I crave, but their secrecy I can't tolerate.

citation.text: Cerulean Sphinx (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Szadek is confident that House Dimir's truth will remain hidden.
timeline.quote: even the most perceptive would still be fundamentally unprepared for the truth of House Dimir.

citation.text: Glimpse the Unthinkable (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Grand Arbiter Augustin IV is killed by an explosion during an attack by the spirit of Szadek.
timeline.quote: who was later killed by an explosion during an attack by the spirit of the-Dimir guildmaster Szadek

citation.text: "Azorius Senate", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Savra, helped by Szadek, takes control of the guild, resurrects Svogthir to overthrow the Sisters, and proclaims herself guildmaster.
timeline.quote: After this, Savra proclaimed herself as the new Golgari guildmaster.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Savra tries to infiltrate the Selesnya Conclave but is double-crossed by Szadek, who snaps her neck.
timeline.quote: she was double-crossed by Szadek, who snapped her neck to weaken the Conclave.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Dissension, Szadek is defeated with the help of Savra's brother Jarad, who assumes control of the Golgari Swarm.
timeline.quote: In Dissension , Szadek is defeated with the help of Savra's brother, Jarad , who assumes control of the Golgari Swarm.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos arrested Szadek for crimes against the Guildpact, exploiting a loophole that broke the Guildpact's spell.
timeline.quote: The Guildpact's spell was finally broken when Agrus Kos arrested Szadek for crimes against the Guildpact

citation.text: "Guildpact (spell)", section "The original Guildpact". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The vampire Szadek founds House Dimir and signs the Guildpact as one of the ten paruns.
timeline.quote: House Dimir was founded by the ancient vampire Szadek

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos arrests Szadek, breaking the Guildpact's spell and exposing Szadek and House Dimir to the public.
timeline.quote: The Guildpact's spell was finally broken when Agrus Kos arrested Szadek, which exposed him and House Dimir to the public.

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek manipulates Savra and the Selesnya Conclave into killing Mat'Selesnya.
timeline.quote: manipulating Savra and the Selesnya Conclave to do his bidding and kill Mat'Selesnya

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jarad takes control of the lupus and forces them to attack Szadek, defeating him.
timeline.quote: He is ultimately defeated when Jarad takes control of the lupus and forces them to attack him.

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek is arrested by Agrus Kos and imprisoned by the Azorius, who secretly execute him.
timeline.quote: imprisoned by the Azorius who secretly executes him

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A new Guildpact does not recognize House Dimir, but the district of Agyrem reappears under the spirit Szadek's control.
timeline.quote: the district of Agyrem reappeared within Ravnica

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Decamillennial, Agrus Kos arrests the Dimir head Szadek and unwittingly breaks the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: the Guildpact was unwittingly broken when Agrus Kos arrested Szadek

citation.text: "Ravnica", section "The Decamillennial". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Ravnica the Guildpact is broken and the Dissension unfolds.
timeline.quote: The subsequent breaking of the Guildpact and the events of the Dissension

citation.text: "Rift Era", section "Events on Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek partially uproots Vitu-Ghazi during the Decamillennial to drink from Mat'Selesnya.
timeline.quote: uprooted partially by Szadek so he could drink from Mat'Selesnya

citation.text: "Vitu-Ghazi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek says none can oppose one who cannot be found.
timeline.quote: None can oppose one who cannot be found.

citation.text: Infiltrator's Magemark (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Szadek snaps Savra's neck and kills the dryads of the Chorus linked with her.
timeline.quote: Savra’s ally turned on her in an instant, snapping her neck

citation.text: "Decamillennial", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek tears open Vitu-Ghazi and feeds on Mat'Selesnya.
timeline.quote: Szadek began feeding on Mat'Selesnya

citation.text: "Decamillennial", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jarad seizes Savra's staff and turns Szadek's Lupul against him.
timeline.quote: Jarad vod Savo , Savra’s brother, seized Savra’s staff

citation.text: "Decamillennial", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fonn places Bayul's gem on her dying wolf Biracazir, reviving the Chorus and Mat'Selesnya, whose power destroys the shapeshifters and leaves Szadek a charred husk.
timeline.quote: she placed it on her mortally wounded wolf , Biracazir .

citation.text: "Decamillennial", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos arrests Szadek, which technically breaks the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Agrus Kos stepped forward to formally arrest the vampire

citation.text: "Decamillennial", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kos publicly arrests Szadek, finally breaking the Guildpact's spell and exposing House Dimir.
timeline.quote: The Guildpact's spell is finally broken when he publicly arrests Szadek , exposing him and House Dimir to the public.

citation.text: "Dissension", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Evern's partners sold dragon fluid to Lyzolda; they meet contractor Momir Vig and partners Szadek and Savra.
timeline.quote: they sold some of the dragon's liquid to Lyzolda , the acting Guildmaster of the Rakdos.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 6". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Flashback: in Agyrem, the ghost of Szadek kills Razia and Feather flees.
timeline.quote: Then the ghost of Szadek appears and kills Razia.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 9". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Augustin tells Kos he broke the Guildpact by arresting Szadek.
timeline.quote: Kos broke the Guildpact.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 10". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Augustin reveals he took control of the captured Szadek and wants a new Ravnica where everyone follows the law.
timeline.quote: Augstin wants to create a new Ravnica, where everyone follows the law.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 18". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek, released from Kos's grounder, sucks Augustin's soul out, then the Parhelion explodes.
timeline.quote: When Szadek erupts from his prison, he immediately recognizes Augustin and sucks his soul right out of his body.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 18". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Szadek's death, Lazav gathers what remains of the Dimir and has a new Duskmantle built.
timeline.quote: Lazav managed to gather what was left of the Dimir and bring them together.

citation.text: "Lazav", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Szadek murders Savra, Svogthir's spirit takes over her corpse and allies with Momir Vig to use Project Kraj.
timeline.quote: Svogthir's spirit took over the treacherous elf 's corpse

citation.text: "Svogthir", section "Last sighting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek manipulates the Guildpact into a paradox, causing its disintegration; the Parhelion crashes after its angels are slain in Agyrem.
timeline.quote: Szadek’s actions caused a paradox in the Guildpact, leading to its gradual disintegration.

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek's ghost kills Augustin IV just before the Parhelion explodes and levels Prahv.
timeline.quote: Azorius guildmaster Augustin IV met his demise at the hands of Szadek's ghost

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek is defeated thanks to Jarad and Mat'Selesnya reinvigorated by Biracazir's lifeforce.
timeline.quote: Szadek was defeated thanks to Jarad

citation.text: "Fonn Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gorev tells Pel that Szadek and Augustin destroyed the law and that the play is a tragedy.
timeline.quote: It is the destruction of the greatest creation ever put on paper.

citation.text: "The Absolution of the Guildpact". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The lupuls, thought defeated centuries earlier, resurface under Szadek until Jarad disrupts his control.
timeline.quote: they resurfaced under Szadek 's command, until his control was disrupted by Jarad .

citation.text: "Shapeshifter", section "Lupuls". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek triggers his plan to kill Mat'Selesnya at the Decamillennial; Jarad and Kos stop it and Kos arrests the Dimir guildleader.
timeline.quote: Kos arrested the Dimir guildleader to answer for his crimes

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Life in the Wojek". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kos's spirit is forced to serve as an Azorius Senate spirit guard, and Augustin IV brings him back to stop Szadek.
timeline.quote: Grand Arbiter Augustin IV brought him back for the sole purpose of stopping Szadek

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Parhelion, piloted by Szadek, crashes into the Azorius guildhall.
timeline.quote: piloted by Szadek, crashed into the Azorius guildhall

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kos traps Szadek in a grounder, then throws it at Augustin, freeing Szadek who kills Augustin by removing his soul.
timeline.quote: causing Szadek to break out of the container and kill Augustin by removing his soul

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Arrested him and later trapped him.

relations.note: Szadek and Savra are Vig's partners.
relations.quote: They meet up with their contractor, Momir Vig , and his two mysterious partners, Szadek and Savra .

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 6". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Kos is the only one able to destroy Szadek.
relations.quote: Therefore, Kos is the only person capable of destroying Szadek while Augustin worries about the Guildpact.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 10". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Augustin finished off Szadek in the dungeons and took control of him.
relations.quote: Kos did break the Guildpact, but when Szadek was captured, Augustin finished his eternal enemy off easily in the dungeons and took control of him.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 18". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Shapeshifter", section "Lupuls". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
